comment_box:
Sgt. John K. Martin 1417064350, USMC 6433/6432 '12-'18. Meritorious LCpl even after receiving a Pg. 11. Became CDI at LCpl, youngest in my unit. Also Combat Marksmanship Coach for small arms. Shot perfect CPP scores on both Horno and Iwakuni ranges. 

If you give a single solitary damn about any and all veterans, you will reverse this proposed rule. Forget that it has no basis in science or data, forget that it negates legal precedent, forget that this is blatant christian nationalist theocracy bs: These are VETERANS. We volunteered with our LIVES. We've already endured some of the hardest and purest forms of discrimination, degradation, and disappointment. SO why put us through even more? It's bad enough vets are still not getting the treatment they need to survive and now you want to INCREASE THE HARM DONE?! This is a medical procedure that, if necessary, can be utilized to end a pregnancy if the veteran chooses. Pregnancy is not some minor health issue which the military LOVES to waste money on like Viagra and Ambien would solve, its a life changing medical obstacle that needs care, time, and money to be effectively maintained. If vets just "got pregnant"  or if "all pregnancies are purposeful" then this wouldn't have such serious implications as how denying a veteran who was raped and impregnated would be. 

How many SAPR cases do you think, lets say, a single unit of about 300 Marines in California have? Why is it >0? Aren't we brothers and sisters? 
How many Marines in the last fiscal year have had to be moved to another unit for relationship misbehavior and/or fraternization?
How many overseas 'Sponsors" (E6/E7's) are now married to junior Marines who just so happened to arrive freshly at that SNCO's unit as a E1/E2?
 
Once had a SAPR rep in Iwakuni, the guy you're supposed to go to if you've been sexually assaulted or harassed, try to slyly ask me if I knew that one of my Corporals in my shop was previously a sex worker who posted videos online and asked me if I had seen the video and "if it was good". This is a fellow Sergeant asking me to rate an unknown rumored video containing my Marine performing sex acts that these guys all knew about and shared around. 

They don't call it an invisible war for nothing. 

Seriously reconsider this rule. It does not accomplish any goal besides harming those who were willing to die for people like you and me. Give us the autonomy to do what is best to survive. Civs will never understand the bond I share with many of my Marines. I still follow and support them to this day whether they are living a family life up in VT, training for football, maintaining a datacenter in Dallas, or even still doing hardcharger stuff like Nordic Response and even MARSOC. Let the Doctors and Nurses decide what they can/cannot recommend. 

We're going to the VA to get treated, not to be judged.
